criterion_source.criterion: The same candidate may be reevaluated after substantive new data, linked model, applicable method, corrected constraint, or expressly authorized robustness basis; a new timestamp/UUID alone is insufficient. Both the transition and subsequent validator must be updated, and source/revised task identity retained.
